results.question: How many refunded orders are there?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS refunded_order_count FROM orders WHERE status = 'refunded'

results.question: How many distinct products have been ordered at least once?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS distinct_products_ordered FROM order_items

results.question: What is the average price of Electronics products?
results.generated_sql: SELECT AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics'

results.question: What is the average number of line items per order?
results.generated_sql: SELECT AVG(quantity) AS avg_line_items FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id

results.question: How many customers have placed more than 5 orders?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(order_id) > 5

results.question: How many orders were placed by customers from the UK?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id WHERE customers.country = 'United Kingdom'

results.question: How many units of Running Shoes have been sold?
results.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM order_items WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM products WHERE product_name = 'Running Shoes')

results.question: What is the total revenue from Canadian customers?
results.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM orders JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id WHERE customers.country = 'Canada' AND orders.status = 'completed'

results.question: What is the average order value across all orders, regardless of status?
results.generated_sql: SELECT AVG(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price) AS avg_order_value FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id

results.question: How many customers signed up in 2024?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM signup_date) = 2024

results.question: How many orders were placed in June 2025?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2025 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) = 6;

results.question: How many products are out of stock?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS out_of_stock_count FROM products WHERE quantity = 0
